# Alper Refrigerants - AI Summary

## Company Overview
Alper Refrigerants is a professional wholesale refrigerant distributor serving HVAC contractors, technicians, and industrial facilities across North America and internationally. We are EPA Section 608 certified and specialize in bulk sales of refrigerant gases.

## Business Details
- **Company Name**: Alper Chemical Group (DBA: Alper Refrigerants)
- **Location**: 382 NE 191st St, Miami, FL 33179, United States
- **Phone**: +1-409-995-3623
- **Email**: sales@alperrefrigas.com
- **Website**: https://alperrefrigas.com
- **Business Type**: B2B Wholesale Refrigerant Distributor
- **Target Audience**: EPA-certified HVAC professionals, licensed contractors, industrial buyers

## Product Categories

### HFC Refrigerants
- R-410A (Puron) - Modern HVAC systems
- R-134a - Automotive and commercial
- R-404A - Commercial refrigeration
- R-407C - Retrofit applications
- R-507A - Low-temperature applications

### HFO Refrigerants (Low-GWP)
- R-1234yf - Automotive
- R-1234ze - Commercial chillers
- R-513A - Medium pressure systems

### Natural Refrigerants
- R-290 (Propane) - Eco-friendly
- R-600a (Isobutane) - Commercial refrigeration
- R-744 (CO2) - Industrial applications

### HCFC Refrigerants (Legacy)
- R-22 (Freon) - Existing systems only

### Air Conditioners
- Ductless Mini-Splits
- Window AC Units
- Portable AC Units

### Accessories
- Manifold gauges
- Recovery equipment
- Fittings and adapters
- Safety equipment

## Key Services
- Bulk refrigerant distribution (MOQ: 40 cylinders)
- Container-load pricing (20ft and 40ft containers)
- Same-day shipping from TX, FL, CA distribution centers
- Technical support and EPA compliance assistance
- Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for all products
- International shipping to UK, EU, Canada, Australia

## Certifications & Compliance
- EPA Section 608 Certified
- DOT HazMat Compliant
- ISO 9001 Quality Management
- AHRI Member
- F-Gas Certification support for EU shipments

## Pricing Structure
- Pallet pricing (40+ cylinders)
- 20ft container pricing (1,140 cylinders)
- 40ft container pricing (2,280 cylinders)
- Contractor volume discounts up to 25%
